subject: Request: one-off bridge for lapsed sandbox + short extension
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@genosys.ai>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: procurements@genosys.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: re-open expired sandbox and short extension

Hi Priyom,

We ran a short POC with Redwood in September (account: Genosys AI, sandbox id GNS-4309). The sandbox expired on Oct 1 when a team lead inadvertently turned off the billing card. We made good progress integrating embeddings and a few streaming use-cases; the team needs another run to finalize the evaluation with product and infra before an SOW conversation.

Can Redwood do a one-off reactivation of the sandbox and extend the trial window for ~45 days? Our ask is modest: re-provision the same environment and provide a $2,500 sandbox credit (roughly the same token budget we consumed before). We'll sign whatever short agreement you need and can share a PO or DocuSign MSA.

Attached is a short POC outline (Genosys-POC-outline.pdf) so you can see scope.

Appreciate if you can escalate — timeline is tight: we present internal findings to execs on Oct 20.

Thanks,
Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of ML Engineering, Genosys AI
oliver.grant@genosys.ai
+1 415-555-0192
From: priyom_das@redwood.ai

Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: re-open expired sandbox and short extension

Hi Oliver — thanks for the note and the POC outline. Sorry to hear the billing hiccup caused the expiry right before your exec review.

Quick questions to help us move faster:
- Confirm the sandbox id again (GNS-4309?) and the billing email on file.
- Will you be able to sign a short reactivation addendum / one-time terms? We typically require an MSA or a simple acceptance doc for credits > $1,000.

Policy note: our standard self-serve trial extension is limited, but we can request an exception for sales-assisted accounts. I copied Aditya (sales manager) who can approve an exception if we confirm the business case.

If you can confirm the sandbox id and indicate authorized signer for the DocuSign, I can start the exception request and lock a provisional credit hold to avoid further usage gaps.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

- Duration: 45 days from reactivation
- Usage cap: we will set a soft token cap to prevent runaway consumption; any overage must be approved by Genosys and invoiced after the period
- Conditions: Genosys to sign a short Addendum (DocuSign link below) confirming credit use case, and have a billing card or PO on file. Credit will not auto-charge after expiration.
- Deal id: GN-20261014-1 (for tracking in Redwood CRM)

Attached is the approval memo (exception-approval-20261014.pdf). Once the signed DocuSign or PO is in, Ops can re-provision same sandbox id (GNS-4309) and mark the credit. Priyom — please coordinate with Genosys to get DocuSign executed and loop Ops.

Aditya
